title: Nelson Mandela Released from Prison
description:
On February 11, 1990, **Nelson Mandela** was released from Victor Verster Prison after 27 years of imprisonment by South Africa's apartheid government.

Mandela had been imprisoned since 1962 for his anti-apartheid activism. His release marked a turning point in South African history and paved the way for the end of apartheid.

In 1994, Mandela became South Africa's first Black president in the country's first fully democratic elections.
